description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Composite Golem.
Saffi dies, triggering Yomiji, returning Saffi from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Saffi ability, causing Composite Golem to be returned to the battlefield the next time it dies this turn.
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Saffi triggers, returning Composite Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Saffi by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.
